title: Dhamaal
desc: Roy, Manav, Aditya and Boman chase a hidden treasure in Goa, but as Inspector Kabir gets on their trail, their fun-filled adventure turns into a chaotic race against time.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Nagina (1986)
desc: Rajiv, saved as a child from a snake bite, later marries Rajni. Bhaironath claims she is a snake seeking revenge for her lover, but actually wants her hidden pearl.

title: Nigahen
desc: A snake charmer is in search of a priceless diamond which will bestow him with immense power. However, he discovers that his only hope of locating the diamond is Rajiv and Rajni's daughter Neelam.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Udta Punjab
desc: A rock star, labourer, doctor, and cop struggle with a drug crisis in Punjab. Their lives intertwine as they fight addiction and chaos.

title: Baadshah
desc: A small time private detective gets embroiled in an industrialist's plot to assassinate a political leader.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends meet Ragini in a small town. Her beauty charms them, but soon they realise she brings danger, mystery, and trouble into their lives.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
desc: An astrologer foretells a bright future for Raja, an idle young man, who falls for Shalu, a millionaire's daughter. Her father insists Raja must work hard and earn money to win her hand.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Tadka
desc: A middle-aged Gaurishankar is passionate about food and archaeology but it's a misplaced call from Divya that adds the tadka to his life. While love simmers, Aditi and Sidharth's story spices up too.

title: Yes Boss
desc: Rahul tries to satisfy his demanding and womanizer boss. Rahul has now to choose either to save innocent Seema or to follow his dream of becoming big.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: O' Romeo
desc: A skilled enforcer helps a woman seek justice for her husband's death. As danger grows and enemies close in, their bond deepens amid betrayal and revenge.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.

title: Veere Di Wedding
desc: Kalindi's friends Avni, Sakshi, and Meera reunite for her wedding. Sakshi takes them to Thailand, where they rediscover themselves and confront their personal struggles.
